title: Estimates round: mileage to the nearest 100, hours to the nearest 10
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the Maintenance Reminders QA build as an Owner/Admin (any user who can open Settings > Maintenance and create and edit work orders and customers).
  2. Open Settings > Maintenance, press New schedule and create a throwaway schedule 'ZZAUTOTEST Reading seed' holding one routine service per reading you will seed, named 'ZZ Seed 1', 'ZZ Seed 2' and so on, each with a Calendar trigger of Every 12 months and no canned lines. Save. (If it already exists, reuse it.)
  3. Open Customers > 'ZZAUTOTEST Fleet Co' > Assets and create unit 'ZZAUTOTEST 547' with New Asset, leaving Mileage and Engine Hours empty. On its Maintenance tab press Enroll in Schedule, choose 'ZZAUTOTEST Reading seed' and give every seed service a last service date five years ago (for example 6 Oct 2021), so each seed service reads Overdue and shows on the work order card; press Enroll.
  4. Readings for 'ZZAUTOTEST 547' (oldest first): 1) 6 Sep 2026 · 340,000 mileage · 6,000 engine hours; 2) 16 Sep 2026 · 341,000 mileage · 6,100 engine hours; 3) 26 Sep 2026 · 342,040 mileage · 6,203 engine hours. Dates are for a run on 6 Oct 2026. On another day, move every date by the same number of days and seed and read on the same day, because an estimate and a reading's age both count days up to today.
  5. Seed each reading in the table, oldest first: open Work Orders and press New Work Order for the unit; type the reading's mileage in the work order's Mileage field (and its engine hours in Engine Hours where the table gives one; leave the field untouched where it does not) and save; expand the Maintenance schedule card, open the three-dot menu of a seed service not used yet, choose Mark complete, keep On a work order with this work order chosen, set Reset date to the reading's date and press Mark complete. That work order's values become readings dated the Reset date. Confirm any warning the field shows.
  6. When every reading is in: on the unit's Maintenance tab open the 'ZZAUTOTEST Reading seed' schedule's menu, choose Remove from schedule and confirm, so the seed services add no rows. Check the Mileage card's last recorded value and date match the table's last reading.
custom_steps:
1. Open unit 547's Maintenance tab and read the Mileage card: last recorded value and current estimate.
  2. Work out by hand: rate (342,040 − 340,000) ÷ 20 = 102 a day; estimate 342,040 + 102 × 10 = 343,060.
  3. Read the Engine hours card the same way.
  4. Work out by hand: rate (6,203 − 6,000) ÷ 20 = 10.15 a day; estimate 6,203 + 101.5 = 6,304.5.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The mileage estimate shows 343,100 (343,060 rounded to the nearest 100).
  • The engine hours estimate shows 6,300 (6,304.5 rounded to the nearest 10).
  • The recorded readings show exactly as entered: 342,040 and 6,203, not rounded.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780 (Maintenance Reminders); story SV-10568 (S11, Rate, estimate and confidence); Chunk 2 MR (Confluence 897679389) as edited 5 October 2026, S11; read 6 Oct 2026. Source-verified 6 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S11-R12: “Estimated distance will round to the nearest 100 and estimated hours to the nearest 10. A recorded reading is shown exactly as entered”
  • S18-R19: “Mark complete On a work order also records that work order's mileage and engine hours as the asset's readings, dated the Reset date”
